tasks.title: Admit typed client commands and executable identity
tasks.goal: Define command artifacts that expose effects without making the data renderer a shell.
steps: Map existing fixed client argv builders to admitted operation IDs and typed parameters.
Resolve executable identities at the trusted surface during explicit preparation; bind version/evidence, cwd, environment references and target roots.
Keep novel native-provider execution a separately admitted code capability; reject untyped shell/template evaluation and missing client contracts.
positive_cases: A supported exact client operation serializes deterministic argv from typed values.
Quoted/path-like parameters remain data in the admitted operation recipe.
negative_cases: Interpreter injection, unbound executable and stale version evidence refuse.
A generic file grant cannot authorize process execution or a wider scope.

notes: Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff oracles are conditional on the actual affected inputs, never on the allowed write perimeter alone.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

Accepted prerequisites C1 Work731, C2 Work334 and C3 Work479 are actual archived receipts; no replay. Root selected D1 while B3 authored reader/migration scope remains deferred; D1 full3steps/2positive/2negative/2criteria/safe stop unchanged.

Reuse existing fixed plugin argv operations and declared versions: Claude2.1.x and Codex0.148.x version/list/marketplace-add/install/remove; OpenCode1.17.x version probe only, no plugin subcommands. Unsupported operation/client/version refuses with no fallback. Typed parameters are data, never an arbitrary argv/shell/template language; preserve existing native OsString behavior, reject unrepresentable new wire values rather than lossy re-encoding.

Pure renderer and typed client-command semantics belong to vibe-agent-projection; lifecycle composes preparation, immutable observation and non-deserializable exact process grant. Legacy builders use that same renderer; fixture qualification runs only through incumbent ProcessRunner/ProcessSpec. No new std::process launcher, PTY/session/descendant/resource manager or ambient-authority default. Trusted host supplies production PodBay adapter through existing port; existing legacy direct SystemProcessRunner remains explicit debt, not a migration or production commissioning claim.

Extract/reuse accepted B1 launcher→resolved StableFileState/object-token observation and rechecks from plugin/prepared.rs rather than duplicate it. Trusted host resolves admitted absolute executable during explicit preparation; freeze version/evidence, exact cwd, environment references/actual bound values and target-root capabilities. Query never resolves PATH, probes, hydrates or refreshes stale captures. Current-policy/root/executable/env drift refuses before fixture effects; report actual partial preparation boundaries honestly.

Closed command request/plan e1 is a new inert family, separate from C1 file capability map and generic file grant. Plan exposes actual active argv/content/process effects before approval. Explicit process approval binds entire immutable plan/executable/args/env/cwd/roots/principal/policy; DTO/hash/version marker is not authority. Novel native-provider code remains separately admitted through incumbent native owner; unknown command never falls back to native execution.

Finite exact source/new-family roster; existing process module, SafeFS primitives, context/world/CLI/MCP and native runtime owners remain read-only. No new dependencies required. Unexpected owner change needs exact Root question. Root preauthorized only necessary generator-global schemas/client_command/e1 header insertion with all other old bytes/noncomment bodies preserved, not semantic permission over protected generated files.

One actual Zap→PodBay producer after Root metadata commit/capture; native work is preflight/review only. Root questions/acceptance/Git; human attribution and Conventional Commits. Fresh private TMP and exclusive main warm target; no real client/vendor execution, network, installation, GUI/full suite/Lean/formal replay. Fixture runner observes approved process specification; physical execution policy remains supplied by host/PodBay.
The three exact legacy fixture paths in write_paths are conditional only for necessary import/fixture integration; preserve their behavioral assertions and accepted coverage.

tasks.title: Connect admitted commands to full deployment lifecycle
tasks.goal: Run plan/apply/verify/recover/remove through the existing engine and universal operation service.
steps: Route admitted command/file plans into existing deployment journals and M-16 durable operation IDs; avoid a second deploy engine.
Implement independent observed-state checks, cancellation boundaries and recover/remove using retained host operation data.
Expose equivalent typed CLI/API/MCP outcomes including partial effects and newly required authority on expansion.
positive_cases: A full isolated apply→verify→update→remove preserves foreign state.
Response loss reconnects to the same operation; supported recovery resumes the owned prefix.
negative_cases: A changed executable/descriptor/grant cannot reuse stale authorization.
Provider error after one effect retains partial state instead of returning only text.

D1 is actually WorkAccepted431/rev5/source0a3769398ad981fc5f8f2e0e0f4f2c8664e90a24; original C1/C2/C3 ownership and grant laws remain. Full D2 plan/apply/verify/recover/remove plus update/cancellation behavior is mandatory; plan-only is not acceptance.

Unsupported uncertain command retry refuses, never blindly repeats.

Cancellation is cooperative at pre-dispatch and durable step boundaries; no invented ProcessRunner kill/handle or physical process manager. Stop requests during an in-flight opaque call remain pending until observed safe boundary; retained prefix survives. Supported explicit recovery is a fresh authorized continuation of the same owner operation, not submit re-invocation under a reused key.

Production physical adapter remains host/PodBay supplied; no new std::process/PTY/session/descendant/resource owner, ambient defaults, real vendor/network/platform qualification.
